prompt: Using the attached images ONLY as a style reference (rendering, materials, lighting, palette, composition, background treatment) — do not copy their objects — create a new card illustration of a round brown owl with big amber eyes sitting on a wooden perch standing on a plain flat floor of lighter pink, three-quarter view slightly from above. candidates.comment: Clear owl on perch with good pink contrast, but ornate cape/medallion and glossy toy-like rendering feel less like the references; top margin is tight.

defects: Right foot shows fewer visible toes than the left, making the feet asymmetric.
No rear gripping toes are visible around the perch.
Eyebrow/ear-tuft feathers are asymmetrical, with one side forming a large swept horn and the other merging into the central face feathers.

candidates.comment: Very readable and well framed for category 2, but the cape and emblem are extra decorative elements and the finish is a bit too polished/toy-like.
Readable rounded owl and perch, clean colour, but too ornamental with cloak/badge and slightly AI-toy finish; top area is not very free.

judge.fix: Make the owl simpler and more natural: remove the cape and medallion, reduce the glossy toy finish and fine feather detail, and leave more empty space at the top.
